pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desessantīti --pa--.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.5: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desethā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.9: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.10: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.11.1: na chattapāṇissa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:1.12: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.1: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhū chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ kukkuccāyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.3: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ na desessantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.4: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.6: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.7: anujānāmi bhikkhave chattapāṇissa gilānassa dhammaṃ desetuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.8: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.9.1: na chattapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.11: tīṇi chattāni setachattaṃ kilañjachattaṃ paṇṇachattaṃ maṇḍalabaddhaṃ salākabaddhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.13: buddhabhāsito sāvakabhāsito isibhāsito devatābhāsito atthupasaṃhito dhammupasaṃhito.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.15: padena deseti, pade pade āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk57:2.18: anādariyaṃ paṭicca chattapāṇissa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
